title: Area and Security Lighting Rental LED Conversion Targets and Fixture Changes
content:
Every fixture rented under **Area and Security Lighting Rental** has an LED conversion target: for the legacy HPS and mercury vapor fixtures it is the LED fixture that replaces them, and for the LED fixtures it is the fixture itself. This fact sheet also shows the charge to the member for a cooperative-initiated conversion and the change terms that follow each fixture.

## Conversion targets and conversion charge

| Fixture | LED conversion target | Charge to the member for a cooperative-initiated LED conversion (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| HPS 100W Security Light | LED 40W Security Light | 0.00 |
| HPS 250W Flood Light | LED 110W Flood Light | 0.00 |
| Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light | LED 70W Area Light | 0.00 |
| LED 40W Security Light | LED 40W Security Light (itself) | 0.00 |
| LED 70W Area Light | LED 70W Area Light (itself) | 0.00 |
| LED 110W Flood Light | LED 110W Flood Light (itself) | 0.00 |
| LED 150W Flood Light | LED 150W Flood Light (itself) | 0.00 |

## Change terms by fixture

| Fixture | An existing light may be relocated | The light may transfer with the location to a new member | The new member must confirm taking over the rental |
|---|---|---|---|
| LED 40W Security Light | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| LED 70W Area Light | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| LED 110W Flood Light | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| LED 150W Flood Light | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| HPS 100W Security Light | No | Yes | Yes |
| HPS 250W Flood Light | No | Yes | Yes |
| Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light | No | Yes | Yes |

## Notes

- No legacy fixture converts to the LED 150W Flood Light; that fixture is the conversion target of no legacy fixture other than itself.
- A cooperative-initiated LED conversion costs the member nothing for any fixture.
- Relocation is available for the four LED fixtures only. Transfer with the location, with the new member's confirmation, is available for all seven fixtures.
